audit_question.trigger_rationale: The acquired AppendFuture.Response contract explicitly requires Error to return before Response is called and makes the response valid only on success. The acquired pipelineDecode calls Response without calling Error. This supplies a concrete interface-level concern beyond cross-path asymmetry. The next read resolves whether actual completion producers prevent invalid responses from influencing endpoint reports; it does not assume that the omission establishes unsupported commitment.

input.selection_rationale: Continue the same response-to-report discriminator. The Response contract is now resolved and provides an attributable local expectation; the missing completion producer is the next decisive source dependency. Delivery of an errored future with usable-looking Success would support a bounded consumption check, while success-only delivery would narrow the operational concern without erasing the interface mismatch. Peer attribution and delayed-context isolation remain relevant alternatives, but neither currently offers as direct a discriminator. No check result or evidence is recorded for this candidate.
